dropped_findings.text: C9 says CANCELLED does not take a slot, but the cited data-model section only lists the status values. Nothing in it says which statuses take a slot.

cites.quote: HMS-7 REQ-8: the read-only count in a PATCH body is ignored
They need no change, but their tests and fixtures may need the new field in the client type.

findings.text: PATCH /api/doctors/:id is missing as an indirect effect. HMS-7 required a server-computed detail field to be ignored in PATCH bodies. The new next-7-days field needs the same handling, and DoctorFormPage edits through this route.
